method: Root continuous manual full reads; process output continuations read to terminal before credit. Git identities bind the actually read source; identity alone is not review.
review: Proxy binary root groups domain modules and uses the existing shared support path. No catch-all module or mod.rs introduced.

Configuration tests assert explicit credential categories, concrete source types, static authority text, absent invented causes, and valid inputs. Canary propagation checks Display and Debug over each error chain.

Sibling route tests preserve distinct SOCKS, CONNECT-UDP and HTTP source contracts; invalid template expansion checks the actual nested origin-form type. Expected types and values are explicit, not computed by a copied parser.

Setup, operation and independent assertion groups are readable. Small sync-only error alias need not impose Send/Sync. Source review supports these tests, not all constructor branches or platform behavior.

ConnectionPeer eagerly owns one task; Drop requests abort, Future observes JoinError and typed result, stop has a finite bound, and FixtureFailures preserves both concrete objects. Full helper tests observe actual accepted sockets, completed original error objects and both cause fields.
Supporting production error maps retain concrete source variants and static messages; environment Debug omits submitted values. Only recorded production ranges were read.
qualifications: No runtime, Cargo, browser, capture or performance verification in this source pass.
A canary text scan does not prove that all encodings or all secret-bearing diagnostics are protected; it checks the displayed contracts.
Task Drop requests asynchronous abort and cannot join. stop may time out; a destruction witness does not establish permanent OS resource cleanup.
The local control setup cancellation finding in the separate7ef report remains open; helper correctness does not prove all callers own tasks.
No whole production file or complete codebase coverage follows from partial error-mapping reads.
